figs.name: sensor-linearity-test-and-specification-flowchart
figs.alt: flowchart for testing sensor linearity with best fit straight line and FSO or FRO rating
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing how linearity is tested: apply known inputs, record outputs, fit a reference line, find the largest deviation, then quote it as % of FSO or FRO.
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 590" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Sensor linearity test and specification flowchart</title>
<rect width="800" height="590" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#0c4a6e" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">How Sensor Linearity Is Tested and Specified</text>
<rect x="200" y="56" width="400" height="66" rx="10" fill="#f0f9ff" stroke="#0369a1" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="83.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Apply known inputs</text>
<text x="400.0" y="106.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">across the full range</text>
<circle cx="170" cy="89" r="17" fill="#0369a1"/>
<text x="170" y="95" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">1</text>
<line x1="400" y1="124" x2="400" y2="136" stroke="#0369a1" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="200" y="138" width="400" height="66" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#0369a1" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="165.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Record the output</text>
<text x="400.0" y="188.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">at each point</text>
<circle cx="170" cy="171" r="17" fill="#0369a1"/>
<text x="170" y="177" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">2</text>
<line x1="400" y1="206" x2="400" y2="218" stroke="#0369a1" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="200" y="220" width="400" height="66" rx="10" fill="#f0f9ff" stroke="#0369a1" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="247.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Choose a reference line</text>
<text x="400.0" y="270.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">end point, zero based or BFSL</text>
<circle cx="170" cy="253" r="17" fill="#0369a1"/>
<text x="170" y="259" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">3</text>
<line x1="400" y1="288" x2="400" y2="300" stroke="#0369a1" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="200" y="302" width="400" height="66" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#0369a1" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="329.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Fit BFSL by least squares</text>
<text x="400.0" y="352.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">balances plus and minus deviations</text>
<circle cx="170" cy="335" r="17" fill="#0369a1"/>
<text x="170" y="341" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">4</text>
<line x1="400" y1="370" x2="400" y2="382" stroke="#0369a1" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="200" y="384" width="400" height="66" rx="10" fill="#f0f9ff" stroke="#0369a1" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="411.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Find the largest deviation</text>
<text x="400.0" y="434.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">from that line</text>
<circle cx="170" cy="417" r="17" fill="#0369a1"/>

<polygon points="400,460.0 540.0,500 400,540.0 260.0,500" fill="#fef3c7" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400" y="505.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Unipolar output?</text>
<polyline points="260,500 130,500 130,530" fill="none" stroke="#0369a1" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="195" y="490" font-size="17" fill="#0c4a6e" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Yes</text>
<polyline points="540,500 670,500 670,530" fill="none" stroke="#0369a1" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>

<rect x="20" y="532" width="220" height="50" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#0369a1" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="130.0" y="563.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">± % of FSO</text>
<rect x="560" y="532" width="220" height="50" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#0369a1" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="670.0" y="563.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">± % of FRO</text>
</svg>

figs.name: sensor-linearity-worked-example-infographic
figs.alt: sensor linearity worked example converting 0.25 percent FSO into 25 mV and 0.005 inch error
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog working the article example: a 0 to 2 inch, 0 to 10 V sensor with 0.25% FSO linearity has 25 mV or 0.005 inch error.
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 520" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Sensor linearity worked example: 0 to 2 inch sensor, 0 to 10 V, 0.25 percent FSO</title>
<rect width="800" height="520" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#0c4a6e" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Sensor Linearity Worked Example</text>
<rect x="30" y="58" width="236" height="84" rx="10" fill="#f0f9ff" stroke="#0369a1" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="148.0" y="94.15" font-size="19" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Range</text>
<text x="148.0" y="119.15" font-size="19" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">0 to 2 inches</text>
<rect x="282" y="58" width="236" height="84" rx="10" fill="#f0f9ff" stroke="#0369a1" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="94.15" font-size="19" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Output</text>
<text x="400.0" y="119.15" font-size="19" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">0 to 10 V DC</text>
<rect x="534" y="58" width="236" height="84" rx="10" fill="#f0f9ff" stroke="#0369a1" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="652.0" y="94.15" font-size="19" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Linearity</text>
<text x="652.0" y="119.15" font-size="19" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">±0.25 % of FSO</text>
<rect x="30" y="165" width="740" height="60" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#0369a1" stroke-width="2"/>
<circle cx="64" cy="195" r="17" fill="#0369a1"/>
<text x="64" y="201" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">1</text>
<text x="96" y="202" font-size="19" fill="#0c4a6e" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Full Scale Output</text>
<text x="330" y="202" font-size="19" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">10 V</text>
<rect x="30" y="237" width="740" height="60" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#0369a1" stroke-width="2"/>
<circle cx="64" cy="267" r="17" fill="#0369a1"/>
<text x="64" y="273" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">2</text>
<text x="96" y="274" font-size="19" fill="#0c4a6e" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Linearity error</text>
<text x="330" y="274" font-size="19" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">0.25 % × 10 V = ±25 mV</text>
<rect x="30" y="309" width="740" height="60" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#0369a1" stroke-width="2"/>
<circle cx="64" cy="339" r="17" fill="#0369a1"/>
<text x="64" y="345" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">3</text>
<text x="96" y="346" font-size="19" fill="#0c4a6e" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Scale factor</text>
<text x="330" y="346" font-size="19" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">10 V / 2 in = 5 V per inch</text>
<rect x="30" y="381" width="740" height="60" rx="10" fill="#0369a1" stroke="#0369a1" stroke-width="2"/>
<circle cx="64" cy="411" r="17" fill="#0c4a6e"/>
<text x="64" y="417" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">4</text>
<text x="96" y="418" font-size="19" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Displacement error</text>
<text x="330" y="418" font-size="19" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">25 mV / 5 V per inch = ±0.005 in</text>
<text x="400" y="480" font-size="18" fill="#0c4a6e" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Linearity error becomes a real measurement error in inches</text>
</svg>
